title: Thanks
body: Thank you for being a tool for me that helps me to develop new habits, and as result, build a new way of life.
author: Pavel Ryzhykau

title: Does exactly what you need
body: A simple and intuitive habit tracker. Works from a “high perspective” - e.g. a goal is achieved or not on one given day, no more no less. Use it in conjunction with another app, which tracks few specific other habits that I want to track in greater precision, but it is not that simple and intuitive.
